items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: We opened up when Don Byas was with us on the jam session.

ctx.x: saying that this is a non-union place. They said, "If you don't come out in a half hour I'm going to report you to the union." Dick Wilson stuck his head out and said, "Man, go ahead now because we're going to jam." We stayed there and went back the next day. We didn't care what he did because during that era everybody was just thirsting to play. You just had to play someplace.
